delhi_token.opens_days_before_basis: the 25 October 2026 sitting, whose download window opens on 19 October — the most recent edition DSLSA has published a window for (the 10 October edition it superseded would have opened 5 days ahead, on 5 October, and the 9 May 2026 sitting's window opened 5 days ahead too, on 4 May) — so 5-6 days ahead is DSLSA's observed pattern, not a fixed rule.
delhi_token.daily_cap_note: For the 25 October 2026 sitting, DSLSA's notification (Ref. No. 10/DSLSA/ADRW/NLAs/2026/11105 dated 9 September 2026) said that compoundable challans pending till 30.06.2026 would be taken up, and that violators could download the challan slips from the Delhi Traffic Police link "from 19.10.2026 at 10 a.m. onwards, subject to a maximum limit of 50,000 challans per day, till exhausting the overall limit of 2 lakh challans" — the same cutoff date and caps carried over unchanged from the 10 October notification it replaced.
delhi_token.limits_note: That notification set no closing date for the download window and no per-vehicle limit — the window runs until the overall 2 lakh cap is exhausted, not until a fixed date. Delhi's National Lok Adalat has now moved twice: first from 12 September 2026 to 10 October 2026 (Ref. No. 10/DSLSA/ADRW/NLAs/2026/10673 dated 25 August 2026, because the Delhi High Court had declared 12 September a court sitting day for subordinate courts), then from 10 October 2026 to 25 October 2026 (Ref. No. 10/DSLSA/ADRW/NLAs/2026/11105 dated 9 September 2026, because the Delhi High Court's Notification No.86/G-4/Genl.-I/DHC dated 8 September 2026 declared 10 October itself a court sitting day for subordinate courts). Re-checked 1 October 2026: fetched the Ref. No. 11105 PDF directly (its text is machine-readable, not image-scanned as an earlier check assumed) via dslsa.org's own listing, and independently corroborated the 25 October date, the 19 October token-window opening, and the unchanged caps/cutoff against press coverage (Sunday Guardian, Inkl); no newer DSLSA notification supersedes these facts as of this check. Re-checked 5 October 2026 (within the 21-day window of the 25 October sitting): dslsa.org's public-notices listing, sorted newest first, still shows the 09.09.2026 postponement notice as the latest Lok-Adalat-dated item on file (newest listed notice overall is an unrelated 03.10.2026 empanelment circular) — no further postponement or token-window change has been published. Re-checked 9 October 2026: dslsa.org's public-notices listing again shows no notice newer than the 09.09.2026 postponement bearing on the Lok Adalat date or token window (newer listed items are unrelated empanelment/recruitment notices) — the 25 October date, 19 October window opening, and caps stand unchanged.

delhi_extras.weekend_courts_note: Outside National Lok Adalat dates, Delhi's district court complexes have run weekend traffic courts since July 2026, alongside evening traffic courts on working days. Challan slips are downloaded from the Delhi Traffic Police portal, choosing a court complex and a slot; the rosters are published as circulars by the district courts.

state_notes.note: Karnataka is not sitting on 12 September 2026. The Karnataka State Legal Services Authority postponed the third National Lok Adalat to Saturday 19 September 2026, 2.00 p.m. to 5.30 p.m., by letter No. KSLSA:08/NLA/2026 dated 18 August 2026, addressed to every District Legal Services Authority in the state. If your challan is in Karnataka, 19 September is the date that applies to you.

Delhi's National Lok Adalat has moved twice. It was first postponed from 12 September 2026 to Saturday 10 October 2026, by Ref. No. 10/DSLSA/ADRW/NLAs/2026/10673 dated 25 August 2026, because the Delhi High Court had declared 12 September a court sitting day for courts subordinate to it (Notification No.85/G-4/Genl.-I/DHC dated 21 August 2026). It was then postponed again, from 10 October 2026 to Sunday 25 October 2026, by Ref. No. 10/DSLSA/ADRW/NLAs/2026/11105 dated 9 September 2026, because the Delhi High Court declared 10 October itself a court sitting day for subordinate courts (Notification No.86/G-4/Genl.-I/DHC dated 8 September 2026). If your challan is in Delhi, 25 October 2026 is the date that applies to you, and the traffic-challan token download window now opens 19 October 2026 at 10 a.m., not 5 October.
